==English==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|en|enlightment}} {{q|rare}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|enlighten|-ment|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈlaɪtənmənt/|/ənˈlaɪtənmənt/|/-laɪtmənt/}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-enlightenment.wav|a=Southern England}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|-|s}}

# An act of [[enlighten]]ing, or the state of being enlightened or [[instruct]]ed.
# A [[concept]] in spirituality, philosophy and psychology related to achieving clarity of perception, reason and knowledge.
#* {{quote-book|en|date=31 July 2014 |editor= Oliver C. Speck |page=25|title=Quentin Tarantino's Django Unchained: The Continuation of Metacinema
|url= https://books.google.co.nz/books?id=sJnNAwAAQBAJ |publisher=w:Bloomsbury|isbn= 9781623567804 |passage= Thus Django becomes the carrier of the “public use of one's reason”—the Kantian road to '''enlightenment''' given to him by the German “Forty-Eighter” dentist–turned-bounty hunter Dr. “King” Schultz, and represents the fictive, allohistorical ''beginning'' of the battle against slavery and racism in the United States.}}

* {{l|en|peace that passeth understanding}}
* {{l|en|bodhi}}, {{l|en|nirvana}}, {{l|en|satori}}, {{l|en|zen}}
